title: Pork with celeriac and mustard
summary: Pork with celeriac and mustard is a british dinner built around pork fillet and celeriac, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat pork fillet dry and season it. Prep celeriac and gluten-free Dijon mustard for Pork with celeriac and mustard so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook pork fillet on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook celeriac and gluten-free Dijon mustard in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Pork with celeriac and mustard before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice pork fillet and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
